cases.sentence: Монассии было двенадцать лет, когда он стал ___.
cases.translation: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king.
cases.explain: The verb 'стал' (became) governs the instrumental case for predicate nominatives.

cases.sentence: Его мать звали Хевциба, и правил он в Иерусалиме под властью ___.
cases.translation: His mother was named Hephzibah, and he ruled in Jerusalem under the authority of the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition 'от' (from, of) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: He did evil in the sight of the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) with glазах governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он отстроил святилища на возвышенностях, которые разрушил его ___.
cases.translation: He rebuilt the high places which his father had destroyed.
cases.explain: The possessive 'его' (his) requires the genitive case form.

cases.translation: He built altars in the house of the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) with location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Я помещу мое имя в Иерусалиме и в этом ___.
cases.translation: I will put my name in Jerusalem and in this house.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) governs the prepositional case for location.

cases.sentence: Я не дам впредь ногам израилетян выйти из той ___, которую я дал их отцам.
cases.translation: I will no longer allow the feet of Israel to leave that land which I gave their fathers.
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from, out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Монассия пролил столько безвинной крови, что наполнил Иерусалим от края до ___.
cases.translation: Manasseh shed so much innocent blood that he filled Jerusalem from one end to the other.
cases.explain: The preposition 'до' (until, up to) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Монассии было двенадцать лет, когда он стал царем, и правил он в Иерусалиме пятьдесят пять лет.
reading.question: How old was Manasseh when he began to reign, and how long did he rule in Jerusalem?
options: Twelve years old, reigned fifty-five years
Twenty-two years old, reigned thirty-one years
Eight years old, reigned thirty-one years
Fifteen years old, reigned forty years
reading.correct: Twelve years old, reigned fifty-five years
reading.explain: The text states 'Монассии было двенадцать лет' (Manasseh was twelve years old) and 'правил он в Иерусалиме пятьдесят пять лет' (he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem).

reading.ru: Он делал зло в глазах Господа, следуя омерзительным обычаям народов, которых Господь прогнал от израилетян.
reading.question: What did Manasseh do that was evil, and whose practices did he follow?
options: He followed the abominable practices of nations that the Lord had driven out before Israel
He followed the righteous ways of David his ancestor
He refused to follow the law of Moses
He destroyed all the high places in Jerusalem
reading.correct: He followed the abominable practices of nations that the Lord had driven out before Israel
reading.explain: The text says he did evil 'следуя омерзительным обычаям народов, которых Господь прогнал от израилетян' (following the abominable practices of nations which the Lord had driven out before Israel).

reading.ru: Он отстроил святилища на возвышенностях, которые разрушил его отец Езекия, воздвиг жертвенники Баалу и сделал столб Ашеры.
reading.question: What religious structures did Manasseh rebuild and create?
options: High places, altars to Baal, and an Asherah pole
reading.correct: High places, altars to Baal, and an Asherah pole
reading.explain: The passage states he 'отстроил святилища на возвышенностях' (rebuilt high places), 'воздвиг жертвенники Баалу' (raised altars to Baal), and 'сделал столб Ашеры' (made an Asherah pole).

reading.ru: Он принес сына в огненную жертву, гадал и ворожил, и общался с вызывателями умерших и волшебниками.
reading.question: What abominable practices did Manasseh engage in concerning spiritual matters?
options: He made his son pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, and consulted mediums and spiritists
He taught people the law of Moses
He consulted the prophets about the will of God
He established priesthoods throughout the land
reading.correct: He made his son pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, and consulted mediums and spiritists
reading.explain: The text explicitly lists: 'принес сына в огненную жертву' (made his son pass through fire), 'гадал и ворожил' (practiced sorcery), and 'общался с вызывателями умерших и волшебниками' (dealt with mediums and spiritists).

reading.ru: Монассия упокоился со своими предками и был похоронен в саду своего дворца, в саду Уззы.
reading.question: Where was Manasseh buried?
options: In the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza
In the royal tombs of Judah
In Egypt where his fathers came from
reading.correct: In the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza
reading.explain: The text states he was 'похоронен в саду своего дворца, в саду Уззы' (buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza).

reading.ru: Приближенные Омона составили против него заговор и убили царя в его дворце.
reading.question: How did King Amon die?
options: His servants conspired against him and killed him in his palace
He was defeated in battle by his enemies
He was killed by the prophets for his sins
reading.correct: His servants conspired against him and killed him in his palace
reading.explain: The passage clearly states 'Приближенные Омона составили против него заговор и убили царя в его дворце' (The servants of Amon conspired against him and killed the king in his palace).
